column4: PR 825 (deploy runbook names the scripts outside the repo). CI shows 4 red test jobs (tests 3.11 to 3.14) on the current head (gh pr checks <n>). Read the failing test names from the run log first. Likely causes after batches m12b, m13 and m14 moved main to ccd013d4: the branch is behind main (merge main into the PR branch; no force push), docs/ENVIRONMENT.md first-read anchors shifted (fix with tools/environment_anchors.py --fix), or a boundary-echo allowlist count. Fix only what is red, push to the PR branch, confirm `gh pr checks` is green, report the new head SHA (the keeper then queues a re-review). No force push, no .github changes, no secret printed or committed.

Ruling in comms/inbox/architect/20261107-1100-architect-A-RULE-PR495-vs-PR866-and-821-vs-850.md (PR 495 lands, PR 866 is cut back). Behaviour otherwise unchanged: a bad value still falls back and the gateway starts; ceilings and ranges as built; explicit create_app arguments still win. Also close reviewer-7's A19 (assert state.latency_budget_ms == 5.0 for the explicit argument). Update the five rows in docs/ENVIRONMENT.md (the nothing is logged text becomes the warning and the field) and keep tools/environment_anchors.py --check at 0 wrong rows. Done when: tests that a junk value, a value over the ceiling, NaN and inf each give the default AND exactly one warning naming the variable AND an env_fallbacks entry, that the value (use a sentinel string) appears in no log line, no /health field and no exception text, that an unset or valid value gives no warning and an empty env_fallbacks; mutants (warning dropped, value echoed in the warning, env_fallbacks missing, one warning per request instead of per process, valid value warns) die; CI green, GX10 on the exact head. Do not touch PR 866 or its branch. Don-only and non-blocking (recommended as built): the ceilings and cooldown 0.
